title: More powerful file management and customization
notes: New: Browse folders in a dedicated folder tree, open TAR archives as read-only folders, and create or open password-protected ZIP and 7z archives.
New: Search for and install plugins from GitLab and Forgejo, sync third-party plugins with your fman account, and open the settings folder from the command palette.
Improved: File operations now have a global transfer queue, better handling of locked files and canceled moves, parallel deletion, and more reliable clipboard and virtual-file support.
Improved: Customize panes and file lists with compact multi-column layouts, mixed file-and-folder sorting, more columns, hidden plugin columns, and pane-division commands.
Improved: Windows integration now includes shell overlay icons, Explorer replacement mode, taskbar jump lists, per-window taskbar buttons, and better path handling.
